question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Calculate the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS root_id,
        p.id AS current_id,
        1 AS depth,
        CAST(1 AS BIGINT) AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging p
    WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.depth + 1,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(1.0 * leaf_totals.total_leaf_qty) AS avg_total_quantity
FROM (
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_leaf_qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    WHERE pt.current_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
    GROUP BY pt.root_id
) leaf_totals
